Perks › Legendary

Final Warning

Legendary perk · Information

When Rival holds one bone, the safest legal play location is marked.

In-game card text

How it works

When Rival is down to one bone, the safest legal place for the bone you hold is marked.

  • "Blocks rival" means Rival's last bone can't be played after your play.
  • "Safest play" means the play that leaves Rival the smallest scoring reply.
  • Extra copies change nothing.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeInformation
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Win 15 matches; Go domino 40 times; Make a 60-point play), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
